title: Lumenfen: A Fictional Orientation-Aid Study
authors: N. V. Arden and K. S. Ilex (fictional)

sections.label: 2. Twelve-week results
sections.text: In the 12-week Lumenfen study, the author-reported mean orientation score was 82.4 points (SEM 1.2), based on 36 participants. The score range was prespecified as 0 to 100 points. No participant-level orientation scores are included in this excerpt.

sections.label: 3. Statistical reporting
sections.text: The analysis summarizes means with standard errors of the mean (SEM). This excerpt does not provide confidence-interval bounds or a confidence-interval calculation for the orientation score. Table 1 is an exploratory comparison and was not adjusted for baseline differences.

sections.label: Table 1. Reed-site exploratory completion times
sections.text: At the Reed site only, mean completion times were 8.1 minutes for Compass A and 9.4 minutes for Compass B (n=12 per group; exploratory, unadjusted). No completion-time results for other sites are reported in this table.
